notes.title: Attention Gamers
notes.content:
Hey guys!

Just wanted to let you know...
This game is hard, really really hard.
It's not for the faint of heart.
So if you're a casual gamer, don't get this game.
Only the few that are up to it can beat it.

notes.title: SURVIVAL MODE RELEASED!
notes.content:
Great news for anyone that loves new content that tests their
 rogue-ish skills under increasingly demanding conditions: We've gone
 ahead and added the brand new SURVIVAL mode to Rogue Contracts:
 Syndicate as a free post-launch update!
 
 Battle an increasing number of enemy agents while perfecting your
 lethal skills, and learn how to fully take advantage of a
 color-changing mansion's layout in RC:S's latest mode. Set up
 ambushes, survive impossible odds relying on stealth, and know that
 only the very best -- the elite -- can survive the gauntlet.
 
The time to challenge your friends (and, possibly, enemies) has come!
 

- Go Dark Team

notes.title: Version 1.1.6 Released
notes.content:
The latest, sleeker version of Rogue Contracts: Syndicate has been
released, and, as you will notice, it is focused on speed.

We have edited and upped the pace of the game's introduction,
streamlined the tutorial mission, fixed several glitches, and managed
to speed everything up.

What's more, there are new and much improved sound effects throughout
the game --the sounds of the SMG and the sword slash, to give two
examples-- and we've even touched up the story and RCS's dialog.

Finally, to top things up, we've released a new trailer.

Let us know what you think!
